values.note: Suggested donations, not set fees: $10 minimum for camping at the Rock County Fairgrounds (paid to the Rock County Ag Society), $25 a night at the city's pads west of the fishing ponds (paid to the City of Bassett); $5 to use the dump. The city page is undated; a motorhome camper paid $10 at the fairgrounds in September 2025.

booking.source: https://www.bassettnebr.com/camping-fishing-gun-range ('Camping areas are first come first serve'; 'RV camping pads west of the Fishing Ponds are available on a first come first serve basis'), read 2026-11-05

note: RV camping spread through the Rock County Fairgrounds and Bassett City Park south of US-20: fairground sites (donations to the Rock County Ag Society) and the city's pads west of the fishing ponds, 2 of them accessible (donations to the City of Bassett). Water from hydrants around the grounds, not at the sites. Spaces are very limited during the Sandhills Ranch Expo in June, the Rock County Fair at the end of August and the High School Rodeo the weekend after; call City Hall to check dates. A September 2025 camper found the fairground 30/50-amp hookups not turned on. --Claude
summary: City page confirms first-come camping at the fairgrounds and the city pads west of the fishing ponds, by suggested donation ($10 minimum at the fairgrounds per the sign, $25 at the city pads), 20/50 A receptacles, hydrants and sewage access; no count on the page. Inclusion passes: ordinary nights outside events, and a motorhome paid $10 for an ordinary night in 9/2025. Fees low 25 -> 10. Not waterfront stands (the ponds are ~1.5 acres). Pin OK.
flags: INCLUSION passes (fair-ground rule): the city page offers camping as ordinary first-come nights, not event-only ('Camping areas are first come first serve. There are several RV & camping areas with electricial hook ups throughout the City Park & Fairgrounds areas'; 'RV camping pads west of the Fishing Ponds are available on a first come first serve basis'), with events only limiting space ('Spaces are very limited during events such as the Sandhills Ranch Expo in June, the Rock County Fair at the end of August, & the High School Rodeo'). The page is undated; the 2024+ date comes from an RV Life review, 9/2025, Motorhome, $10, an ordinary overnight at the fairgrounds. That review also says the electric was not turned on, so hookups may be seasonal or event-only (in the note, dated; hookups left at 50).

FEES changed: nightly_low 25 -> 10 (the fairground sign's 'Suggested Minimum Donation of $ 10 for Camping'), nightly_high 25 (city pads). Both are suggested donations. The 2026-10-15 read took only the $25 line.
SITE COUNT: none on the page (only '2 handicap spots' at the city pads). Left absent.

AMPERAGE: page 'Volts of 120/240 & 20/50 Amp receptacles'; the 9/2025 camper saw '30 and 50 amp hookups'. electric 50 stands (derived; the page does not say these are at individual sites, so I left the group alone).
SEASON: stored year_round true rests on note prose; the page says nothing about a season. Left; 'Open year-round' dropped from the note because it restates the field.

WATERFRONT not waterfront stands: the city pads are on the park road west of the two fishing ponds; Kid Wade Pond measures 1.52 acres by NAIP NIR flood-fill and Doc Middleton Pond is smaller, both under the 5-acre pond line. No other water.

PIN OK: stored 42.57850,-99.54100 is in the fairgrounds by the arena and barns, ~100 m from Google's 'Rock County Fairgrounds' point (42.57819,-99.54221). The city pads west of the ponds are ~400-500 m SW in the same grounds (not a split: one park and fairgrounds, one road system).
PHONE 402-684-3338 confirmed (Bassett City Hall on the page). Website unchanged.
